description:
Use this when the user wants their posting queue times changed: "post at 6pm on weekdays", "add Saturday at
        noon to my queue", "clear my queue times". slots: the whole new list, each with a day (Monday to Sunday, or
        daily, weekdays, weekends) and a time (18:30 or 6:30pm, the user's local time); up to 70. It replaces the old
        list, so call get_queue_times first and include the times to keep; an empty list clears the queue. The answer
        shows the previous list.
        Not for: scheduling a post (update_draft with schedule) or choosing times from the user's results
        (best_time_to_post). Free. It only saves the times; nothing is posted.
name: set_queue_times
title: Set queue times
